options.name: advertiseondefaultpartition
options.description: Advertise VIPs from Shared VLAN on Default Partition.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: arp
options.description: Respond to ARP requests for this IP address.

options.name: arpowner
options.description: The arp owner in a Cluster for this IP address. It can vary from 0 to 31.

options.name: arpresponse
options.description: Respond to ARP requests for a Virtual IP (VIP) address on the basis of the states of the virtual associated with that VIP. options.name: bearer_token
options.description: Authentication bearer token. Needed when doing an ADM service proxy call.

options.name: bgp
options.description: Use this option to enable or disable BGP on this IP address for the entity.

options.name: decrementttl
options.description: Decrement TTL by 1 when ENABLED.This setting is applicable only for UDP traffic.

options.name: disabled
options.description: When set to C(true) the nsip state will be set to C(disabled). When set to C(false) the nsip state will be set to C(enabled).

options.name: dynamicrouting
options.description: Allow dynamic routing on this IP address. Specific to Subnet IP (SNIP) address.

options.name: ftp
options.description: Allow File Transfer Protocol (FTP) access to this IP address.

options.name: gui
options.description: Allow graphical user interface (GUI) access to this IP address.

options.name: hostroute
options.description: Option to push the VIP to ZebOS routing table for Kernel route redistribution through dynamic routing

options.name: hostrtgw
options.description: IP address of the gateway of the route for this VIP address.

options.name: icmp
options.description: Respond to ICMP requests for this IP address.

options.name: icmpresponse
options.description: Respond to ICMP requests for a Virtual IP (VIP) address on the basis of the states of the virtual associated with that VIP. options.name: instance_id
options.description: The id of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The target Citrix ADC instance ip address to which all underlying NITRO API calls will be proxied to. It is meaningful only when having set C(mas_proxy_call) to C(true)

options.name: instance_name
options.description: The name of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: ipaddress
options.description: IPv4 address to create on the Citrix ADC. Cannot be changed after the IP address is created. Minimum length =  1

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: When performing a Proxy API call with ADM service set this to C(true)

options.name: mas_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a Citrix ADM node to the target Citrix ADC instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token) When true and adm service is the api proxy the following option must also be defined: I(bearer_token) When true you must define a target ADC by defining any of the following parameters I(instance_ip) I(instance_id) I(instance_name)

options.name: metric
options.description: Integer value to add to or subtract from the cost of the route advertised for the VIP address. Minimum value = C(-16777215)

options.name: mgmtaccess
options.description: Allow access to management applications on this IP address.

options.name: netmask
options.description: Subnet mask associated with the IP address.

options.name: networkroute
options.description: Option to push the SNIP subnet to ZebOS routing table for Kernel route redistribution through dynamic protocol.

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds until a timeout error is thrown when establishing a new session with Citrix ADC

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the Citrix ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ospf
options.description: Use this option to enable or disable OSPF on this IP address for the entity.

options.name: ospfarea
options.description: ID of the area in which the type1 link-state advertisements (LSAs) are to be advertised for this IP (VIP) address by the OSPF protocol running on the Citrix ADC. When this parameter is not set, the is advertised on all areas. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(4294967294)

options.name: ospflsatype
options.description: Type of LSAs to be used by the OSPF protocol, running on the Citrix ADC, for advertising the route this VIP address.

options.name: ownerdownresponse
options.description: in cluster system, if the owner node is down, whether should it respond to icmp/arp.

options.name: ownernode
options.description: The owner node in a Cluster for this IP address. Owner node can vary from 0 to 31. If ownernode is specified then the IP is treated as Striped IP.

options.name: restrictaccess
options.description: Block access to nonmanagement applications on this IP. This option is applicable for MIPs, SNIPs, and and is disabled by default. Nonmanagement applications can run on the underlying Citrix ADC Free BSD system.

options.name: rip
options.description: Use this option to enable or disable RIP on this IP address for the entity.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If true the module will save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: snmp
options.description: Allow Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) access to this IP address.

options.name: ssh
options.description: Allow secure shell (SSH) access to this IP address.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the Citrix ADC node. When present the resource will be created if needed and configured according to the module's parameters. When absent the resource will be deleted from the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: tag
options.description: Tag value for the network/host route associated with this IP.

options.name: td
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain in which you want to configure the entity. you do not specify an ID, the entity becomes part of the default traffic domain, which has an ID of TD id 4095 is used reserved for LSN use . Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(4095)

options.name: telnet
options.description: Allow Telnet access to this IP address.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the IP address to create on the Citrix ADC. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vrid
options.description: A positive integer that uniquely identifies a VMAC address for binding to this VIP address. This is used to set up Citrix ADCs in an active-active configuration using VRRP. Minimum value = C(1) Maximum value = C(255)

options.name: vserver
options.description: Use this option to set (enable or disable) the virtual server attribute for this IP address.

options.name: vserverrhilevel
options.description: Advertise the route for the Virtual IP (VIP) address on the basis of the state of the virtual servers with that VIP. * NONE - Advertise the route for the VIP address, regardless of the state of the virtual servers with the address. * ONE VSERVER - Advertise the route for the VIP address if at least one of the associated virtual is in UP state. * ALL VSERVER - Advertise the route for the VIP address if all of the associated virtual servers are UP state. * VSVR_CNTRLD - Advertise the route for the

options.name: vserverrhimode
options.description: Advertise the route for the Virtual IP (VIP) address using dynamic routing protocols or using RISE * DYNMAIC_ROUTING - Advertise the route for the VIP address using dynamic routing protocols (default) * RISE - Advertise the route for the VIP address using RISE.
